Inventory App - Windows version
================================

HOW TO RUN
1. Double-click "run-web.bat"
2. Your browser opens the app at http://localhost:8080

No installation needed. Uses built-in Windows PowerShell to serve the app.

NOTES
- Data is saved inside the browser (local). Clearing browser data
  deletes it.
- A USB barcode scanner works like a keyboard; just plug it in.
- Close the "Inventory Server" window to stop the app.

TO REBUILD FROM SOURCE (needs Flutter SDK)
  flutter build web --release
  then replace the "web" folder here with build/web
  (keep run-web.bat, serve.ps1 and this file)
